axes_source: Read from data/brands/framer.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #FFFFFF and the canvas #090909; contrast from the ink #FFFFFF on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #FFFFFF; density from its 1px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 10, 15, 20, 30px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #FFFFFF reaches 19.91:1 on the canvas #090909, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
